choices.text: Pull the codes and run a full diagnostic before giving the driver any time estimate.
Try the most likely fix first, a clogged fuel filter, and get him moving if it works.
Ask Pao, who knows this engine family well, what he would check first.

response.text: A fruit hauler limps into your Manteca shop at 7:00 with a check-engine light and low power. The driver has peaches due in Los Angeles by evening. Brenda has already promised him a quick look.
response.title: Truck down on the 99
